title: Out of order: identity activity arrives before the change
summary: The identity provider's record is delivered before the CDC-shaped bank change. Flink buffers it (bounded) and applies it when the change arrives, so the payment is still correlated correctly.

steps.label: Supplier baseline
steps.caption: Northstar Logistics: three-year relationship, established account •••• 1842.

steps.label: Identity activity (arrives early)
steps.caption: The identity record for change CHG-1001 is delivered first: Flink has not yet seen CHG-1001.
steps.notice: Receipt BUFFERED_AWAITING_CHANGE; context stays v1. It is held in bounded keyed state, not discarded.

steps.label: Beneficiary change (arrives late)
steps.caption: The CDC-shaped change CHG-1001 arrives (its business time is earlier than the identity record's).
steps.notice: Context v2 for the change, then v3 when the buffered identity record is applied. Its receipt is upserted to APPLIED_FROM_BUFFER.

steps.label: Payment request
steps.caption: A USD 75,000 payment to •••• 9077 is requested.
steps.notice: Correlated despite the arrival order: MANUAL_REVIEW using context v3.
